acid.initialization: Lognormal number integrated over ten native soluble-bin edges, no renormalization; each bin assigned native midpoint per-particle dry volume. This preserves binned number, not analytic lognormal third moment. Other species and seven insoluble bins zero.
acid.reservoir_convention: After every native/JAX step, restore H2SO4 to its initial value and account for target-minus-poststep gas as external sulfur. Native internal depletion during the timestep is retained and checked by half-timestep repeats.

checked_provenance.scope: complete salsa call; nsoa=0, no HAMMOZ, native 69-component mapping, 17 bins, five nonwater species; strided checkpoints; optional post-call constant H2SO4 reservoir restoration; every-step finite and sulfur checks
checked_provenance.output_order: checkpoint, case, native level, field component

definitions.relative_L1: sum(abs(coarse-fine))/sum(abs(fine)), summed over bins/components and cells; maximum over saved times
definitions.mass: Native aerosol sulfate molecule concentration; other aerosol species are zero in these runs
definitions.control: No coagulation, condensation or nucleation; native hydration/remapping/correction still execute
definitions.limits: Small port differences and budgets do not independently establish redistribution accuracy. All strict acceptance flags retained.
